blocks.text: Aeroplane ka par is tarah banaya jata hai ke hawa mur jaye aur par ke oopar streamlines neeche ke muqable zyada qareeb hon (Fig. 5.17). Hum dekh chuke hain ke jahan streamlines qareeb hon wahan speed zyada hoti hai. Is liye par ke oopar hawa neeche se tez chalti hai. Par ke oopar pressure kam aur neeche zyada hota hai, is liye par oopar ki taraf dhakela jata hai; aeroplane ki lift (oopar uthne wali force) isi asar se hai.

blocks.alt: Hawai jahaz ke pichhle hisse ka side view, aage par (wing) ka section. Baen se aati sabz streamlines par ki muri hui oopri surface par bohat qareeb jama hoti hain aur neeche phaili rehti hain, sab daen taraf chalti hain. Par ke neeche laal teer oopar ki taraf hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 5.17: Hawai jahaz ki lift (kitab ki Figure 5.17 ke mutabiq original drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Jahan streamlines qareeb hain wahan hawa tez aur pressure kam hai. Par ke oopar hawa tez (pressure kam) aur neeche aahista (pressure zyada) hai; neeche ka zyada pressure (laal teer) par ko oopar dhakelta hai: yahi lift hai.
